items.description: Этот транспорт должен сдвинуться на свою двойную длину за каждые совершаемые 90 градусов поворота.

Djong.name: Djong
Djong.descriptionHazard:
Djongs are immense multi-decked outriggers used by the Tian-Sing for transit within the Minata archipelago. Similar in design to the smaller karakoa, djongs have an open hull design that makes them very fast and exceptionally stable, capable of carrying hundreds of rowers on their decks, as well as a large woven triangular sail on a mast. The broad platforms on the djongs made them excellent for ferrying cargo, and their size and stability enabled them to host hundreds of warriors and their gear for transport. During peacetime, djongs are often used to host major celebrations and important weddings, with dignitaries bringing large entourages on their own djongs and then rafting up with other celebrants to form a floating village.

The size of the djongs is limited by the availability of the large timber required to form each of its twin hulls. Many of the giant trees suitable to build djongs have been harvested, making the surviving djongs even more valuable, with their overall length becoming a metric of status for their owners.

items.name: Неповоротливый
items.description: Этот транспорт должен сдвинуться на свою двойную длину за каждые совершаемые 90 градусов поворота.

Duskwood Corvette.name: Duskwood Corvette
Duskwood Corvette.descriptionHazard: This triple-masted warship is crafted mainly from sturdy duskwood brought down from Andoran's Darkmoon Vale. Naval captains must prove their worth before securing a post on such a valuable vessel.

items.name: Stealthy
items.description: Due to its ebony coloration, a duskwood corvette is difficult to detect under certain conditions. It is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W] in dim light.

items.name: Оружейные крепления
items.description: This vehicle has 2 weapon mounts, one on each side of the vehicle. At purchase, these weapon mounts are initially empty. Installing or uninstalling a weapon into a mount requires 1 day, a successful @Check[crafting|dc:28] check, and an appropriate weapon. The weapon mounts can be equipped with Huge or smaller ranged siege weapons.

Firefly.name: Светлячок
Firefly.descriptionHazard: Светлячок сочетает в себе магию и технологию, используя магию электричества и магнетизм, чтобы парить прямо над землей. Хотя светлячок по форме больше похож на коробку, чем на насекомое, он получил свое название благодаря постоянному свечению света и питающей его магии электричества, а также благодаря стабилизирующим магнитам, которые выступают по бокам примерно в тех же местах, где выступали бы крылья.

items.name: Вспышка
items.description: Пилот перегружает транспорт, в результате чего оно создает вспышку брильянтового света. Все существа, попавшие в яркий свет от его ауры "Свечения", должны преуспеть в спасброске @Check[fortitude|dc:19|name:Избежать вспышки]{Стойкости}, иначе будут @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Ослеплены} на 1 минуту. Свет светлячка тускнеет на 10 минут, уменьшая его свечение до 10-футового тусклого света, и в это время он не может использовать "Вспышку". "Вспышка" перестаёт работать, если светлячок сломан.

items.name: Свечение
items.description: Питаемое магической молнией, это транспортное средство излучает яркий свет в 20 футах и тусклый свет в следующих 20 футах.

items.name: Парение
items.description: Это транспортное средство удерживается в воздухе с помощью быстро вращающихся пропеллеров, которые позволяют ему парить в воздухе на высоте @Unit[Foot|1]{1 фута}. Оно не способно лететь выше, и когда пилот останавливает магию или транспортное средство ломается, оно опускается на землю на 1 фут.

items.name: Jump Jet
items.description: The firework pgo moves exclusively via @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leaping}. For each action spent to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.uS3qDAgOkZ7b8ERL], the pogo Leaps 20 feet horizontally or 10 feet vertically.

items.name: Unstable Launch
items.description: When the pilot uses a 3-action activity to recklessly @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.uS3qDAgOkZ7b8ERL] the firework pogo, it emits a burst of flames on launch that deals @Damage[3d6[fire]] damage to the pilot, the pogo itself, and each creature in a 10-foot radius (@Check[reflex|dc:19|basic] save).

Floating Camouflage Blind.name: Floating Camouflage Blind
Floating Camouflage Blind.descriptionHazard: The floating camouflage blind comprises a wooden platform fastened to a pair of pontoons and is powered by a small clockwork motor. On this platform are four short walls, with a canvas cover providing protection from the elements. Typically, the outside of the blind is painted to blend in with any surrounding foliage. Floating camouflage blinds are often placed near the mouth of strategic waterways so that traffic can be stealthily monitored.

items.name: Заводка
items.description:
10 minutes of wind-up, 1 hour of operational time, [[/act disable-device dc=19]]{DC 19}, standby

For a clockwork to act, it must be wound with a unique key by another creature. This takes 1 minute. Once wound, it remains operational for the listed amount of time, usually 24 hours, after which time it becomes unaware of its surroundings and can't act until it's wound again. Some clockworks' abilities require them to spend some of their remaining operational time. They can't spend more than they have and shut down immediately once they have 0 time remaining. If it's unclear when a clockwork was last wound, most clockwork keepers wind all their clockworks at a set time, typically 8 a.m.

A clockwork that lists standby in its wind-up entry can enter standby mode as a 3-action activity. Its operational time doesn't decrease in standby, but it can sense its surroundings (with a -2 penalty to Perception). It can't act, with one exception: when it perceives a creature, it can exit standby as a reaction (rolling initiative if appropriate).

A creature can attempt to Disable a Device to wind a clockwork down (with a DC listed in the wind-up entry). For each success, the clockwork loses 1 hour of operational time. This can be done even if the clockwork is in standby mode.

Flying Fortress.name: Flying Fortress
Flying Fortress.descriptionHazard: The ultimate battlefield command center, this massive skyborne castle serves as a platform for launching aerial assaults on land-based and sea-based enemy positions. By hovering over an enemy position, the flying fortress can lay waste to enemies who lack countering siege weapons by firing down on their frontline defenses.

items.name: Габарит
items.description: 70 feet long, 70 feet wide, 80 feet high

items.name: Неповоротливый
items.description: Этот транспорт должен сдвинуться на свою двойную длину за каждые совершаемые 90 градусов поворота.

items.name: Оружейные крепления
items.description: This vehicle has eight weapon mounts, with two on each side of the fortress. At purchase, these weapon mounts are initially empty. Installing or uninstalling a weapon into a mount requires 1 day, a successful @Check[crafting|dc:40] check, and an appropriate weapon. These weapon mounts can be equipped with Huge or smaller ranged siege weapons.

Flying Submersible.name: Flying Submersible
Flying Submersible.descriptionHazard: This tubular vehicle flies with the aid of a pair of large gas-inflated balloons. With a clockwork-powered aft propeller, the vehicle can move forward if there are no extreme headwinds. Upon landing in the water, the balloons are deflated and stowed within the vehicle, while the aft propeller continues to move it on the surface of the water. By filling a long ballast tank in the vehicle's keel, it can then submerge and travel underwater. The vehicle can stay submerged for only 1 hour until it must resurface to refresh its oxygen supply. The weapons of this vehicle are in a special compartment that allows them to be fired and reloaded underwater.

items.name: Габарит
items.description: 60 feet long, 40 feet wide, 40 feet high

items.name: Земноводный
items.description: This vehicle can land on water and then submerge up to a depth of 200 feet.

items.name: Deploy Balloons
items.description: The pilot engages a lever that activates the clockwork components to launch two massive tethered balloons and fill them with lighter-than-air gas. This grants the flying submersible a fly Speed of 30 but removes its swim Speed. This transformation lasts until the pilot disengages the balloons by performing this action again.

items.name: Оружейные крепления
items.description: This vehicle has two weapon mounts. At purchase, these weapon mounts are initially empty. Installing or uninstalling a weapon into a mount requires 1 day, a successful @Check[crafting|dc:36] check, and an appropriate weapon. The weapon mounts can be equipped with Huge or smaller ranged siege weapons.

items.name: Манёвренность
items.description: С полным набором умелых гребцов, гребная галера может быстро поворачивать, разворачиваться на месте и даже грести назад. Каждый поворот на 90 градусов, сделанный менее чем за длину транспорта, стоит 5 дополнительных футов движения. Она может грести назад не быстрее половины своей Скорости, и она не может поворачивать во время гребли назад.

Geobukseon.name: Geobukseon
Geobukseon.descriptionHazard:
These squat vessels are built with a protective shelllike covering on their deck rather than the open main deck design of most sailing vessels. The fully covered deck protects the vessel's 80 rowers and complement of 50 soldiers from arrows and incendiary weapons. In addition, this armored deck is covered with iron spikes to discourage enemies from attempting to board.

On the bow of the vessel is mounted a dragon head which can emit sulfur smoke to effectively hide its movement in close combat. Below the dragon head is mounted a large anchor with a wooden crest shaped like a face, and these can be used to ram into enemy ships.

items.name: Smoking Breath
items.description: When the geobukseon Stops, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W] by the smoke for 1 round or until it next moves. The geobukseon can't use this concealment to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa] or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4].

items.name: Turtleback Spikes
items.description: The roof of a geobukseon is difficult terrain and hazardous terrain. A creature that moves on the roof takes @Damage[1d6[piercing]] damage for every square of that area it moves into. Falling @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60] on the geobukseon's roof deals @Damage[5d6[piercing]] damage.

items.name: Начальное падение
items.description: Единственный способ запустить планер — спрыгнуть с крутого склона при благоприятном состоянии ветра. Планер неуправляем и каждый раунд падает на 60 футов, пока пилот успешно не @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yh9O9BQjwWrAIiuf]{Возьмёт управление}. Если планер упадет на землю до того, как пилот успешно "Возьмёт управление", то и пилот и планер получают урон от падения.

Helepolis.name: Helepolis
Helepolis.descriptionHazard: The helepolis uses both pushed propulsion and turned propulsion to turn a capstan. Turned propulsion uses the same rules as rowed propulsion. Pushed propulsion uses the same rules as pulled.

items.name: Неповоротливый
items.description: Этот транспорт должен сдвинуться на свою двойную длину за каждые совершаемые 90 градусов поворота.

items.name: Tiered
items.description: A helepolis has six levels. The crew operate at the bottom tier, turning a giant capstan. There's room remaining on that tier for up to six passengers (enough for a full heavy ballista siege crew; see Weaponry). Each of the remaining five levels carries up to 60 passengers. The tiers are specifically meant to be protective and give those within the helepolis greater cover (or standard cover if the helepolis is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]). A massive ladder runs diagonally through the center of the helepolis, from the front of the top tier to the rear of the bottom tier. The ladder is wide enough for two crew or passengers to climb simultaneously.

items.name: Weaponry
items.description: The siege tower is loaded to the brim with siege weapons—typically bristling with heavy ballistas on its first and second tiers and ballistas on its third, fourth, and fifth. The Price of these weapons is included in that of the helepolis. When building a helepolis, you can choose to replace any of these with other siege weapons with a lower Price. If you want a more expensive siege weapon, you must Craft it separately. Because of the helepolis's structure, any siege weapon in it must launch its payload straight ahead. For instance, a ballista or springald could function in a helepolis, but not a catapult or trebuchet. Passengers of the helepolis can crew these siege weapons.

Hellclad Trireme.name: Hellclad Trireme
Hellclad Trireme.descriptionHazard: This imposing warship is known for transforming into an ironclad juggernaut when plates of blackened iron covered in spikes are lowered over its rowing ports. Most hellclad triremes have threatening figureheads shaped like screaming devils.

items.name: Armor of Nessus
items.description: Over the course of 1 minute, the ship's crew lowers spiky metal plates across key sections of the hull. The ship gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its AC and immunity to precision damage. Its collision damage becomes piercing damage. Its weakness to fire is reduced to 5, but its swim Speed is reduced to 15 feet and it can no longer be rowed. The crew can retract the plates by taking another minute.

items.name: Оружейные крепления
items.description: This vehicle has 2 weapon mounts, one on each side of the vehicle. At purchase, these weapon mounts are initially empty. Installing or uninstalling a weapon into a mount requires 1 day, a successful @Check[crafting|dc:31] check, and an appropriate weapon. The weapon mounts can be equipped with Huge or smaller ranged siege weapons.

Hillcross Glider.name: Hillcross Glider
Hillcross Glider.descriptionHazard:
Hillcross gliders are made of bone and stretched hide, tied together with

sinew, and sealed with a glue made from animal fat.

items.name: Начальное падение
items.description: The only way to launch a Hillcross glider is to jump off a steep incline with favorable wind conditions. The glider is uncontrolled and falls 60 feet each round until the pilot successfully @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.yh9O9BQjwWrAIiuf]{Takes Control}. If the glider hits the ground before the pilot Takes Control, the pilot and the glider both take falling damage.

items.name: Дрейф
items.description: The hot air balloon lacks steering and relies on favorable wind currents to carry it in the right direction. If the pilot fails to maintain control of the hot air balloon, the balloon drifts whichever way the wind carries it, moving up to four times its Speed each round as determined by the GM.

Ice Breaker.name: Ice Breaker
Ice Breaker.descriptionHazard: Colder oceans are often beset with heavy layers of sea ice, providing some kingdoms natural barriers to sea-based assaults and bombardments. To counter this, as well as to resupply troops in these areas, engineers designed massive steam-powered ice breakers. Powered by a dozen steam boilers lit with arcane flames, these ships can make their way through heavy ice fields that would crush most vessels, leaving an open channel behind them for other ships to follow.
Ice Breaker.speedVehicle: swim 40 feet or 20 feet in heavy ice (clockwork, magical)

items.name: Габарит
items.description: 120 feet long, 40 feet wide, 50 feet high

items.name: Проход через льды
items.description: This vessel can move through sea ice up to 20 feet thick, leaving a path of open water behind it.

items.name: Неповоротливый
items.description: Этот транспорт должен сдвинуться на свою двойную длину за каждые совершаемые 90 градусов поворота.

items.name: Оружейные крепления
items.description: This vehicle has eight weapon mounts; one each on the bow and stern, and three mounted on each side. At purchase, these weapon mounts are initially empty. Installing or uninstalling a weapon into a mount requires 1 day, a successful @Check[crafting|dc:40] check, and an appropriate weapon. The weapon mounts can be equipped with Huge or smaller ranged siege weapons.

Iceboat.name: Iceboat
Iceboat.descriptionHazard: In addition to sailing across open water, this vessel can also travel at high speeds over frozen rivers, lakes, oceans, and fjords.

items.name: Ледоход
items.description: Ice is not difficult terrain for iceboats. However, they're unable to travel over land unless it's completely covered in ice.

items.name: Steel Keel
items.description: Iceboats have steel blades affixed to their keels and outriggers that enable them to travel over ice at tremendous speed.

Ironclad.name: Ironclad
Ironclad.descriptionHazard: This heavy gunboat features solid hardwood timbers covered with thick iron plates riveted together to protect the portions of the vessel above the waterline. These timbers slope inboard at an angle to reduce the effectiveness of siege projectiles and cannon shots. The vessel is powered by a twin pair of propellers spun by steam from boilers that are magically fired, yielding glowing blue smoke through its twin pair of smokestacks. Ironclads are so formidable that a single one has been known to blockade an entire port by itself against more traditional wooden ships.

items.name: Габарит
items.description: 100 feet long, 60 feet wide, 20 feet high

items.name: Неповоротливый
items.description: Этот транспорт должен сдвинуться на свою двойную длину за каждые совершаемые 90 градусов поворота.

items.name: Оружейные крепления
items.description: This vehicle has four weapon mounts, two on each side of the vehicle. At purchase, these weapon mounts are initially empty. Installing or uninstalling a weapon into a mount requires 1 day, a successful @Check[crafting|dc:40] check, and an appropriate weapon. The weapon mounts can be equipped with Huge or smaller ranged siege weapons.

Karakoa.name: Karakoa
Karakoa.descriptionHazard: Karakoa are large twin-hulled outriggers used by the Tian-Sing for transit within the massive Minata archipelago. Fast and sturdy, karakoa are distinct from other Tian vessels in that they're equipped with platforms for transporting warriors and fighting at sea. During peacetime, they're also used as trading ships, able to carry goods and passengers. While capable of crossing oceans, their open hull design may perform poorly during rough seas as breaking whitecaps could swamp the craft.

items.name: Слабость 10 к огню пока не сломано
Манёвренность
items.description: With a full complement of skilled rowers, a rowed longship can turn swiftly, turn in place, and even row backwards. Each 90-degree turn made in less than a vehicle length costs 5 extra feet of movement. It can row backwards no faster than half its speed, and it can't turn while rowing backwards.

Medical Wagon.name: Medical Wagon
Medical Wagon.descriptionHazard: Medical wagons are frequent sights near the battlefield. These wagons carry various mundane and magical medical supplies and are generally staffed by a medic. A small gurney is mounted in the back of the wagon for transporting personnel or for use as an emergency operating table.

items.name: Enhanced Medicinal Tools
items.description: When attempting a Medicine check inside a medical wagon, you gain a +2 item bonus.

Mobile Command Post.name: Mobile Command Post
Mobile Command Post.descriptionHazard: This utilitarian vehicle resembles a small encampment, complete with protective barriers, a kitchen, sleeping quarters, and partitioned offices, all mounted on ironclad timbers. Beneath these timbers is a series of cogs and wheels, enclosed by a solid chain track made of iron plates. These tracks enable the mobile command post to move over all types of terrain, albeit at a slow pace. Once in position, these tracks fold up, allowing the vehicle's base to rest on the ground while providing extra protection along the sides of the vehicle.

items.name: Габарит
items.description: 90 feet long, 50 feet wide, 20 feet high

items.name: Неповоротливый
items.description: Этот транспорт должен сдвинуться на свою двойную длину за каждые совершаемые 90 градусов поворота.

Mobile Inn.name: Передвижная таверна
Mobile Inn.descriptionHazard: Передвижная таверна —- следующий шаг вперед по сравнению с @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.vehicles.Actor.WjOkOaWOGkLmuSq5]{Бронированной каретой}, который предоставляет ограниченные удобства простой (и тесной) таверны, чтобы сделать дальние поездки более терпимыми для богатых путешественников. По сути, это крошечный постоялый двор на колёсах, работающий на алхимических катализаторах и паровом двигателе, оснащённый печью, шкафом для утвари, умывальником, столом, двумя скамьями и компактным спальным чердаком, достаточно большим для размещения 4 человек. Его можно модифицировать, чтобы разместить 1 пассажира с гораздо большим комфортом или легко вместить 5 пассажиров, убрав все удобства.

Necro Roamer.name: Necro Roamer
Necro Roamer.descriptionHazard: Favored by necromancers, this vehicle is a heavily fortified, armored wooden shed mounted on the legs of a dozen undead creatures.

items.name: Оружейные крепления
items.description: This vehicle has two rooftop weapon mounts. At purchase, these weapon mounts are initially empty. Installing or uninstalling a weapon into a mount requires 1 day, a successful @Check[crafting|dc:36] check, and an appropriate weapon. These weapon mounts can be equipped with Large or smaller ranged siege weapons.

items.name: Aerial Launch
items.description: Nighthawks can be carried into battle beneath a larger airship and dropped from higher altitudes.

items.name: Переносная
items.description: Плот могут нести по суше 2 Средних существа или 1 Большое. Во время этого существа @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Перегружены}.

items.name: Переносная
items.description: Вёсельную лодку могут нести по суше 2 Средних существа или 1 Большое. Во время этого существа @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Перегружены}.

items.name: Неповоротливый
items.description: Этот транспорт должен сдвинуться на свою двойную длину за каждые совершаемые 90 градусов поворота.

items.name: Sand Skimmer
items.description: The sand barge can travel over sand, water, and quicksand equally well, but it can't traverse solid ground.

Sand Diver.name: Песчаный ныряльщик
Sand Diver.descriptionHazard: Песчаный ныряльщик — транспортное средство в форме скорпиона, использующее для передвижения алхимическую тягу. Хвостоподобная часть действует как теплоотвод и выпускает алхимические пары позади водителя, когда он зарывается. Вместо клешней у него спереди два механизма для рытья, которые позволяют ему прокапывать через песок.

items.name: След осколков
items.description: Песчаный ныряльщик может @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.H6v1VgowHaKHnVlG]{Рыть} только сквозь песок, используя жар и пламя из своего алхимического ядра, чтобы медленно рыть себе путь. Алхимические испарения, остающиеся после него, задерживаются под землей по мере "Рытья", временно катализируя фрагменты песка в стеклоподобный побочный продукт. Существа, которые "Роют" через пространство, в котором за последние 24 часа "Рыло" это транспортное средство, получают @Damage[1d12[piercing]] от осколков (@Check[fortitude|dc:17|basic|name:Избежать осколков]). Существо, которое продолжает "Рыть" через тот же участок пространства, через который недавно "Рыл" песчаный ныряльщик, должно продолжать совершать этот спасбросок каждый раунд, когда оно первый раз "Роет" через осколки.

items.name: Неповоротливый
items.description: Этот транспорт должен сдвинуться на свою двойную длину за каждые совершаемые 90 градусов поворота.

items.name: Burning Exhaust
items.description:
Attempt a two-action Piloting check to Drive the sand racer.

Критический успех: The sand racer moves up to its Speed and can turn normally. Choose up to two creatures that the sand racer was adjacent to when it began this movement. Both of those creatures take @Damage[6d6[fire]] damage from the sand racer's burning exhaust (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic]).

Успех: As critical success, but choose only one creature.

Провал: As success, but the creature gains a +4 circumstance bonus to its Reflex save, and the sand racer moves its Speed in a straight line.

Критический провал: You fail to blast any creatures with the burning exhaust. The sand racer moves its Speed in a straight line and becomes uncontrolled.

items.name: Ускорение
items.description:
Частота: Раз в 10 минут

Эффект: The pilot triggers an injection of thasteron directly into the sand racer's engine to briefly increase its speed. For 1 round the sand racer's Speed becomes 180 feet, all piloting checks with the sand racer gain the reckless trait, and the pilot gains a +2 circumstance to any Acrobatics or piloting checks made to navigate specific challenges. A speed boost is terribly inefficient, and consumes a day's worth of fuel.

items.name: Exploratory Kit
items.description: Sand racers were built to aid in long-distance exploration of Akiton's sandy wastelands, and have storage capacity for 14 days of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.L9ZV076913otGtiB] for a Medium creature and 14 days of fuel. They also have a small storage compartment in the front designed to store a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.vLGDUFrg4yGzpTQX]{Repair Kit} and replacement parts for the more delicate pieces of machinery

Sandsailer.name: Sandsailer
Sandsailer.piloting: Athletics (DC 39), Driving Lore (DC 34), Sailing Lore (DC 34), or Nature (DC 39)

Second Kiss.name: Second Kiss
Second Kiss.descriptionHazard: The Second Kiss is a massive rigid airship. An oval fabric envelope stretched over a wood‑and‑metal frame contains a dozen sealed gasbags of floranine gas that provide lift to get the vessel airborne. A pair of clockwork‑powered propellers mounted in nacelles on either side of the crew cabin provides forward motion. Crew steer the ship with rudders and ailerons in four massive tail fins.

items.name: Неповоротливый
items.description: Этот транспорт должен сдвинуться на свою двойную длину за каждые совершаемые 90 градусов поворота.

items.name: Наэлектризовать
items.description:
Частота: Раз в минуту

Эффект: Two crew members each perform a 2-action activity on their turn to emit an electrical pulse, dealing @Damage[6d6[electricity]] damage to all creatures within @Template[emanation|distance:10]{10 feet} of the shark diver. Crew and passengers of the shark diver are unaffected. Affected creatures must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:28|basic] save.

items.name: Погружаемый
items.description: The shark diver can travel beneath the surface of the water, carrying an air reservoir suitable to sustain 11 Medium creatures for up to 24 hours. The shark diver can safely reach depths of up to 300 feet. If broken, the shark diver loses air from its reservoir, reducing the stored air by 10 minutes per round. A broken shark diver has its maximum depth reduced by half.

Siege Barge.name: Siege Barge
Siege Barge.descriptionHazard: These special barges were designed to siege river and oceanside fortresses and enemy encampments. In addition to carrying two huge siege weapons and their crews, these barges also hold a variety of stones and other siege projectiles.
Siege Barge.piloting: Nature (DC 41 to 46 depending on the pulling creatures) or Sailing Lore (DC 39)
Siege Barge.speedVehicle: the Speed of the slowest pulling creature (pulled by 4 Huge creatures)

items.name: Габарит
items.description: 60 feet long, 30 feet wide, 20 feet high

items.name: Неповоротливый
items.description: Этот транспорт должен сдвинуться на свою двойную длину за каждые совершаемые 90 градусов поворота.

items.name: Оружейные крепления
items.description: This vehicle has two weapon mounts. At purchase, these weapon mounts are initially empty. Installing or uninstalling a weapon into a mount requires 1 day, a successful @Check[crafting|dc:39] check, and an appropriate weapon. The weapon mounts can be equipped with Huge or smaller ranged siege weapons.

Siege Dragon.name: Siege Dragon
Siege Dragon.descriptionHazard: Crafted to appear as a chunky adamantine dragon at a distance, this vehicle is designed to scare civilians and intimidate enemy armies on the battlefield below.

items.name: Frightful
items.description: A creature who is within 100 feet of a siege dragon at the start of its turn must succeed a @Check[will|dc:39] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is then temporarily immune to this effect for 24 hours.

items.name: Оружейные крепления
items.description: This vehicle has a weapon mount. At purchase, this weapon mount is initially empty. Installing or uninstalling a weapon into the mount requires 3 hours, a successful @Check[crafting|dc:39] check, and an appropriate weapon. The mount can be equipped with a Large or smaller ranged siege weapon.

Siege Tower.name: Siege Tower
Siege Tower.descriptionHazard: The siege tower uses pushed propulsion, which uses the same rules as pulled.
Siege Tower.speedVehicle: 10 feet (pushed by the pushers in the crew)

items.name: Неповоротливый
items.description: Этот транспорт должен сдвинуться на свою двойную длину за каждые совершаемые 90 градусов поворота.

items.name: Tiered
items.description:
A siege tower has five levels. The bottom level houses the crew, and each higher level carries up to 10 passengers. The tiers are specifically meant to be protective and give those within the siege tower greater cover (or standard cover if the siege tower is broken). Each tier is connected to the one above it by a 7-foot ladder.

The siege tower has a corvus at its highest tier: a vertical bridge that can be lowered to allow creatures to cross gaps. Lowering the corvus takes a total of 3 Interact actions. Moving the siege tower while the corvus is lowered is highly dangerous, especially for anyone on the corvus. When it's open, creatures in the top tier don't have cover from the side with the corvus, and creatures on the lowered corvus don't have cover except from below.

Skimmer.name: Skimmer
Skimmer.descriptionHazard: This sleek vessel generally appears as a fast-moving catamaran. Using a pair of clockwork mechanisms, the main hulls can be lifted out of the water, with only the narrow blade of their keels remaining slightly below the surface, turning the skimmer into an even faster hydrofoil, doubling its normal speed.
Skimmer.speedVehicle: swim 30 feet or 60 feet using hydrofoil (wind)

items.name: Deploy Hydrofoil
items.description: The skimmer's hydrofoils are deployed by pulling a lever, doubling the vehicle's normal Speed. However, this makes the vehicle less maneuverable, and it must move twice its length for each 90-degree turn it makes while the hydrofoils are deployed. The pilot can take this action again to retract the hydrofoils and return the skimmer to its normal Speed and maneuverability.

Sky Chariot (Heavy).name: Sky Chariot (Heavy)
Sky Chariot (Heavy).piloting: Arcana (DC 33), Nature (DC 33 to 41, depending on pulling creature), or Piloting Lore (DC 31)
Sky Chariot (Heavy).speedVehicle: the fly Speed of the slowest pulling creature (pulled by 6 Large creatures, 2 Huge creatures, or 1 Gargantuan creature)

Sky Chariot (Light).name: Sky Chariot (Light)
Sky Chariot (Light).piloting: Arcana (DC 25), Nature (DC 25 to 33, depending on pulling creature), or Piloting Lore (DC 23)
Sky Chariot (Light).speedVehicle: the fly Speed of the slowest pulling creature (pulled by 2 Large creatures or 1 Huge creature)

Sky Chariot (Medium).name: Sky Chariot (Medium)
Sky Chariot (Medium).piloting: Arcana (DC 29), Nature (DC 29 to 37, depending on pulling creature), or Piloting Lore (DC 27)
Sky Chariot (Medium).speedVehicle: the fly Speed of the slowest pulling creature (pulled by 4 Large creatures, 2 Huge creatures, or 1 Gargantuan creature)

Sky Chariot, Armored.name: Sky Chariot, Armored
Sky Chariot, Armored.descriptionHazard: This open-air vehicle is constructed similar to a sleigh, with four wheels in the place of runners and a set of sweeping wings extending from its sides. The wooden body of the vehicle is armored to protect the occupants, who can fire handheld weapons over the gunwales to gain cover from ranged attacks.
Sky Chariot, Armored.piloting: Arcana (DC 34), Nature (DC 34 to 42 depending on the pulling creature), or Piloting Lore (DC 32)
Sky Chariot, Armored.speedVehicle: the fly Speed of the slowest pulling creature (pulled by 6 Large creatures, 2 Huge creatures, or 1 Gargantuan creature)

items.name: Alchemical Launcher
items.description: Two crew members each perform a 3-action activity on their turn to launch a massive alchemical concoction from the chariot. The concoction explodes on impact, dealing @Damage[10d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature in a @Template[type:burst|distance:15] up to 50 feet away (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save).

Sled.name: Сани
Sled.piloting: Знания вождения (КС 14), или Природа (КС от 16 до 24 в зависимости от тянущих существ)
Sled.speedVehicle: the Speed of the slowest pulling creature (pulled by 2 Medium creatures or 4 Small creatures)

items.name: Ледоход
items.description: Ice and snow are not difficult terrain to a sled, but all other terrains are difficult terrain for it.

items.name: Неповоротливый
items.description: Этот транспорт должен сдвинуться на свою двойную длину за каждые совершаемые 90 градусов поворота.

Sleigh.name: Сани
Sleigh.piloting: Знания вождения (КС 15), или Природа (КС от 17 до 25 в зависимости от тянущих существ)
Sleigh.speedVehicle: Скорость самого медленного тянущего существа (тянется 2 Большими существами или 6 Средними)

items.name: Ледоход
items.description: Лёд и снег не являются для саней @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.S55aqwWIzpQRFhcq.JournalEntryPage.z68vgV2XWhi1KYEP#mestnostь]{Сложной местностью}, но вся остальная местность является для них сложной местностью.

items.name: Неповоротливый
items.description: Этот транспорт должен сдвинуться на свою двойную длину за каждые совершаемые 90 градусов поворота.

Smuggler's Speronara.name: Smuggler's Speronara
Smuggler's Speronara.descriptionHazard: This merchant craft has no deck and only one mast. It has a relatively shallow hull for storing cargo, but also several hidden compartments for smuggling illicit goods.

items.name: Манёвренность
items.description: With a full complement of skilled rowers, a rowed speronara can turn swiftly, turn in place, and even row backward. Each 90-degree turn made in less than a vehicle length costs 5 extra feet of movement. It can row backward no faster than half its speed, and it can't turn while rowing backward.

items.name: Smuggling Compartments
items.description: The speronara can hold up to 20 Bulk of items in secret compartments that require a successful @Check[perception|dc:23] check to find.

Snail Coach.name: Карета-улитка
Snail Coach.descriptionHazard: Имея форму одноименного животного-тёзки, карета-улитка представляет собой тележку-троллейбус, приводимую в движение комбинацией магии и алхимических клейких веществ, с твёрдой внешней оболочкой для защиты от атак. Клейкий след позволяет ей подниматься и мешает преследующим врагам.

items.name: Клейкие выделения
items.description: Это транспортное средство выделяет алхимическое клейкое вещество, которое позволяет ему прилипать к твёрдым поверхностям и подниматься по ним. Пространства, по которым движется карета-улитка, на 1 раунд становится @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.S55aqwWIzpQRFhcq.JournalEntryPage.z68vgV2XWhi1KYEP#mestnostь]{Сложной местностью}. Любое существо, которое завершает свой ход на клейком веществе, должно преуспеть в спасброске @Check[reflex|dc:23|name:Избежать клея]{Рефлекса}, иначе получит штраф состояния −10 футов к своим Скоростям на 1 раунд. При критическом провале существо также @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Обездвижено} на 1 раунд ([[/act escape dc=23]]).

Speedster.name: Спидстер
Speedster.descriptionHazard: Спидстер — это легкий обтекаемый гибрид заводного механизма и алхимического шасси с паровым двигателем, по форме напоминающий лошадь или другое существо, приспособленное для скорости. Спидстеры созданы для поддержания быстрого темпа, который на короткие промежутки времени может стать ещё быстрее за счёт высвобождения накопленного парового давления для дополнительного ускорения.

items.name: Ускорение
items.description: Пилот сбрасывает накопившееся давление в алхимическом паровом двигателе спидстера, чтобы временно увеличить его скорость. На [[/r 1d4 #раунды]]{1d4 раунда} Скорость спидстера становится 80 футов, а все действия движения, которые совершает пилот, получают признак @Trait[Reckless]{безрассудство}. Когда пилот совершает действие, которое уже имело бы признак безрассудство, то он использует на одну степень успеха хуже, чем ту, которую он получил при проверке пилотирования. Спидстер не может снова использовать "Ускорение" в течение 1 часа, так как для накапливания давления требует времени.

items.name: Обтекаемый
items.description: Этот облегчённый транспорт не имеет дополнительного места для хранения груза.

items.name: Заводка
items.description: 10 минут завода, 2 часа работы, КС 28, ожидание

Steam Cart.name: Паровая телега
Steam Cart.descriptionHazard: Паровая телега выглядит как телега с алхимическим котлом, который производит пар для приведения в движение телеги с помощью простого двигателя.

items.name: Паровое облако
items.description: Каждый раз, когда паровая телега получает урон от столкновения, ее двигатель выбрасывает плотное облако пара в @Template[emanation|distance:5]{5-футовой эманации}. Паровая телега и все существа в пару становятся @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Скрыты}, а существа вне пара становятся @Condition[Concealed]{скрыты} для существ внутри него. Пар рассеивается за 1 раунд.

items.name: Струя пламени
items.description: Два члена экипажа в свои ходы выполняют активность из 3-х действий, чтобы в конце хода второго персонажа произвести извержение пламени, вырывающееся из любого угла любого пространства, занимаемого паровым гигантом. Пламя наносит каждому существу в @Template[cone|distance:30]{30-футовом конусе} @Damage[6d8[fire]] (@Check[reflex|dc:32|basic]). Струя пламени перестает работать, если паровой гигант сломан.

Steam Trolley.name: Паровая тележка
Steam Trolley.descriptionHazard: Паровая тележка это, по сути, гораздо большая @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.vehicles.Actor.FbSRhHvCmXBSVkrn], с более мощным алхимическим котлом и печью, питающаяся от более мощного парового двигателя.

Steam Turtle.name: Steam Turtle
Steam Turtle.descriptionHazard: This heavily armored aquatic vehicle resembles a gargantuan sea turtle covered with steel plates. The steam turtle is designed for beach landings and assaults on port facilities. Once it disables enemy fortifications, it extends a long boarding gangplank for troops to disembark and deploy.

items.name: Габарит
items.description: 80 feet long, 50 feet wide, 40 feet high

items.name: Неповоротливый
items.description: Этот транспорт должен сдвинуться на свою двойную длину за каждые совершаемые 90 градусов поворота.

items.name: Release Steam
items.description:
Частота: Раз в час

Эффект: Two crew members each perform a 3-action activity on their turn to release a massive buildup of steam around the vehicle, dealing @Damage[11d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] (@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic] save). The release mechanism stops working if the vehicle is broken.

Steelstone Assault Engine.name: Steelstone Assault Engine
Steelstone Assault Engine.descriptionHazard: This steam-powered vehicle has eight sets of axles, each with a pair of huge, spiked metal wheels that are independently powered and can independently shift up and down. This enables the engine to maintain a constant speed even over difficult terrain. On top of the vehicle sits a rotating weapon mount outfitted with a steelstone cannon.

Strider.name: Strider
Strider.piloting: Знания пилотирования (КС 23), Инженерные знания (КС 23), Аркана (КС 25), Ремесло (КС 25)

items.name: Long Reach
items.description: The strider can bridge a gap as wide as 30 feet by Striding over it.

The Dark Prince.name: The Dark Prince
The Dark Prince.descriptionHazard: A massive red-and-black warship, the Dark Prince sports an imposing figurehead of Asmodeus and terrifying faces carved along its gunwales. It patrols the area around the Arch of Aroden, keeping the waters free of pirates and enemies.

items.name: Dreadful Aura
items.description: The flagship of the Chelaxian navy exudes a malevolent air. At the beginning of their turns or when they enter the aura, enemy creatures on board the ship and enemy creatures within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:300] who can see the ship must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:39] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure). Regardless of the result, the creature is temporarily immune to this aura for 1 minute. However, an enemy creature on board can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 until it is no longer on board.

items.name: Оружейные крепления
items.description: This vehicle has 6 weapon mounts, three on each side of the vehicle. At purchase, these weapon mounts are initially empty. Installing or uninstalling a weapon into a mount requires 1 day, a successful @Check[crafting|dc:40] check, and an appropriate weapon. The weapon mounts can be equipped with Huge or smaller ranged siege weapons.

Titanic Stomper.name: Титанический топтун
Titanic Stomper.descriptionHazard: Один из самых опасных транспортных средств, созданных в Усталаве с использованием магии и новых стазиевых технологий, титанический топтун имеет форму длинной извилистой ящерицы или бехира с тщательно расположенными стазиевыми катушками и 8 большими топающими ногами. Титанические топтуны предназначены для уничтожения армий нежити. Их существует всего 2, что делает их почти уникальными, а создание новых застопорилось, поскольку некоторые из важнейших изобретателей были убиты при попытке разработать последующую технологию — меньший, но более мощный механизированный доспех под названием Гробларх, который в конце концов вышел из под контроля и убил своих создателей.

items.name: Удар молнии
items.description: Два члена экипажа в свои ходы выполняют активность из 3-х действий, чтобы в конце хода второго персонажа произвести выстрел линией электричества. Эта линия молнии вырывается из передней части титанического топтуна, под углом по выбору членов экипажа и наносит каждому существу в @Template[line:distance:120]{120-футовой линии} @Damage[5d12[electricity]] (@Check[reflex|dc:34|basic|name:Избежать взрыва]). "Удар молнии" не работает, если титанический топтун @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Сломан}.

items.name: Поглощение электричества
items.description:
Триггер: Титанический топтун является целью или находится в области эффекта, наносящего урон электричеством

Эффект: Пилот использует свою реакцию, чтобы активировать стазиевые катушки, которые отводят электричество в электрический двигатель титанического топтуна. В течение 1 минуты, следующий использованный "Удар молнии" увеличивает свой урон до @Damage[7d12[electricity]|shortLabel].

items.name: Сотрясающий шаг
items.description: Земля сотрясается от каждого шага титанического топтуна. Когда это транспортное средство движется, существа на земле в радиусе 20 футов от траектории его движения должны совершить простой спасбросок Рефлекса КС 32. При провале они застигнуты врасплох на 1 раунд, а при критическом провале — падают @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Ничком}.

Two-Person Submersible.name: Two-Person Submersible
Two-Person Submersible.descriptionHazard: This clockwork vehicle can travel just below the surface of the water for short periods of time to bypass enemy blockades or covertly land on enemy beaches.

items.name: Заводка
items.description:
30 minutes of wind-up, 3 hour of operational time, [[/act disable-device dc=16]]{DC 16}, standby

For a clockwork to act, it must be wound with a unique key by another creature. This takes 1 minute. Once wound, it remains operational for the listed amount of time, usually 24 hours, after which time it becomes unaware of its surroundings and can't act until it's wound again. Some clockworks' abilities require them to spend some of their remaining operational time. They can't spend more than they have and shut down immediately once they have 0 time remaining. If it's unclear when a clockwork was last wound, most clockwork keepers wind all their clockworks at a set time, typically 8 a.m.

A clockwork that lists standby in its wind-up entry can enter standby mode as a 3-action activity. Its operational time doesn't decrease in standby, but it can sense its surroundings (with a -2 penalty to Perception). It can't act, with one exception: when it perceives a creature, it can exit standby as a reaction (rolling initiative if appropriate).

A creature can attempt to Disable a Device to wind a clockwork down (with a DC listed in the wind-up entry). For each success, the clockwork loses 1 hour of operational time. This can be done even if the clockwork is in standby mode.

items.name: Погружаемый
items.description: This vehicle can travel just below the surface of the water.

Undersurf Boat.name: Undersurf Boat
Undersurf Boat.descriptionHazard: Resembling a large, oared kayak with closable hatches, the submersible surfboat was designed by azarketi shipwrights for use above and below the waves.
Undersurf Boat.piloting: Sailing Lore (DC 20), Diplomacy (DC 22), Intimidation (DC 22), or Nature (DC 22)

items.name: Погружаемый
items.description: This vehicle can travel below the surface of the water, usually to a depth of no deeper than 60 feet. Though enclosed, it is not watertight, so crew and passengers must hold their breath or be able to breathe underwater.

Velocipede.name: Velocipede
Velocipede.speedVehicle: The Speed of the pilot (pedaled [as rowed])

items.name: Fragile
items.description: Driving the velocipede over difficult terrain increases the DC by an additional 2 and gains the reckless trait.

items.name: Переносное
items.description: The velocipede can be pulled along the ground on its wheel by a Medium creature. The creature is encumbered.

Vonthos's Golden Bridge.name: Золотой мост Вонтоса
Vonthos's Golden Bridge.descriptionHazard: Созданное волшебником Вонтосом в рамках его попытки пройти Испытание Звёздного Камня в Абсаломе, это странное транспортное средство считается магическим и технологическим чудом. Золотой мост Вонтоса — летающая сфера, сделанная из трона, окружённого несколькими заводными кольцами, покрытыми золотом и самоцветами, наполненными мощными адаптивными защитами, наделяющими его уникальными возможностями.

items.name: Пленительное богатство
items.description:
40 футов.

Золото, самоцветы и другие украшения, покрывающие эту летающую сферу, излучают сверкающее великолепие, способное завораживать существ. Каждое существо, которое начинает свой ход внутри ауры, должно совершить @Check[will|dc:36|traits:magic]; при провале существо @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Заворожено} и @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Одурманено 2}, пока оно остается внутри ауры. Существо, получившее успех, становится временно иммунным на 1 час. Каждый раз, когда активируется "Призматическая защита", область действия "Пленительного богатства" уменьшается на 10 футов на 1 час, до минимального значения 0 футов.

items.name: Защитный барьер
items.description:
Хотя вращающиеся кольца транспортного средства не закрывают пилота полностью, они обеспечивают невероятную защиту, магически поддерживая температуру внутри и отбивая физические атаки. Пилот защищён от сильных холода и жары, а также экстремальных холода и жары. Пилот также получает сопротивление 10 всему физическому урону (кроме адамантина).

items.name: Призматическая защита
items.description: Пилот использует силу магических самоцветов, спрятанных среди экстравагантных украшений этого транспорта, чтобы придать ему дополнительную защиту. Этот транспорт получает сопротивление 20 одному из следующих типов энергетического урона: звук, кислота, огонь, сила, холод или электричество. Это сопротивление действует до следующей активации "Призматической защиты".

War Strider.name: War Strider
War Strider.descriptionHazard: This massive steam-powered vehicle resembles a giant insect with six articulated legs topped with a bulbous turret capable of swiveling 360 degrees to bring its forward-mounted weapons to bear on enemies in any direction. It has weapon ports on either side of its head that give the appearance of eyes. With its long, mechanized legs, it can easily climb over obstacles and cross wide chasms.

items.name: Оружейные крепления
items.description: This vehicle has two forward-mounted weapon mounts. At purchase, these weapon mounts are initially empty. Installing or uninstalling a weapon into a mount requires 1 day, a successful @Check[crafting|dc:37] check, and an appropriate weapon. The weapon mounts can be equipped with Huge or smaller ranged siege weapons.

items.name: Long Stride
items.description: A war strider can bridge a gap as wide as 30 feet during a move action as long as it has sufficient movement remaining.

War Wagon.piloting: Driving Lore (DC 24) or Nature (DC 26 to DC 34 depending on the pulling creatures
War Wagon.speedVehicle: the Speed of the slowest pulling creature (pulled by 6 Large creatures)

items.name: Оружейные крепления
items.description: This vehicle has one weapon mount. At purchase, the weapon mount is initially empty. items.name: Контрмеры
items.description: A creature that Strikes a war wagon with a non-reach melee weapon or unarmed attack takes @Damage[3d8[piercing]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic] save).

Yellow-Sailed Schooner.name: Yellow-Sailed Schooner
Yellow-Sailed Schooner.descriptionHazard: Hailing from Okeno, this schooner usually keeps its allegiance a secret until it gets within boarding range and unfurls its saffron-colored sails.

items.name: Unfurl Yellow Sails
items.description: With the pull of a rope, the pilot or one of the crew unfurls the yellow sails that Okeno freebooters are so infamous for. Each enemy creature within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:100] who can see the sails must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:26] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure). Regardless of the save's results, the creature is temporarily immune to Unfurl Yellow Sails for 24 hours.
